claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are monitored at a monthly frequency (for some risks).
claims.support_notes: Multiple climate risk register entries show monitoring_frequency set to "monthly", supporting disclosure of how climate-related risks are monitored.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are monitored at a quarterly frequency (for some risks).
claims.support_notes: Multiple entries show monitoring_frequency "quarterly", evidencing monitoring approach.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are monitored at a semi-annual frequency (for some risks).
claims.support_notes: Semi-annual monitoring frequency appears in the climate risk register for some risks.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related scenario analysis is used to inform identification/assessment of climate-related risks (linked scenarios are recorded).
claims.support_notes: Presence of scenario_analysis_link fields indicates scenario analysis is referenced/used in the risk process; narrative detail of "how" is not provided in the evidence excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Some climate-related risks have changed since the prior reporting period.
claims.support_notes: At least two register entries indicate changes since prior period; the nature of changes is not evidenced here.

claims.claim_text: Some climate-related risks have not changed since the prior reporting period.
claims.support_notes: Multiple entries indicate no change since prior period; supports disclosure about changes compared with previous period.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk management is integrated into the entity's overall enterprise risk management (ERM) process for many risks.
claims.support_notes: erm_integrated_flag=True across many risks supports integration into overall risk management and supports an integrated disclosure approach (avoid duplication).

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risk management is not integrated into ERM for at least one risk.
claims.support_notes: One entry shows erm_integrated_flag=False, indicating integration is not universal; disclosure should explain extent and how integration occurs.

claims.claim_text: Likelihood scoring is used in assessing climate-related risks (example scores include 3, 4 and 5).
claims.support_notes: likelihood_score fields evidence part of the assessment approach (likelihood). Severity/magnitude methodology details are not fully evidenced in the excerpt.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk ratings are derived from a 5x5 risk matrix using likelihood_score multiplied by severity_score, with thresholds: 1-2 low, 3-6 medium, 8-12 high, 15-25 critical (critical >= 15, high >= 8, medium >= 3, low < 3).
claims.support_notes: Explicit methodology text supports how risks are assessed (criteria/thresholds) and can support prioritisation relative to other risks if applied consistently.
Risk ratings provide evidence of categorisation that can be used for prioritisation; the prioritisation process itself is not described in the evidence excerpt.

claims.claim_text: A documented climate-related physical risk includes chronic heat and shifting precipitation reducing yields for agricultural counterparties, weakening repayment capacity over the medium term.
claims.support_notes: Risk description supports disclosure of the nature of risks; likelihood/magnitude linkage is only partially evidenced elsewhere (likelihood_score).

claims.claim_text: Physical risk exposure data sources include ECB climate indicators.
claims.support_notes: Data source fields support disclosure of inputs/parameters (data sources) used in risk identification/assessment processes.
